tools.description: Change title, description or scheme; set a ref once on a dashboard that has none. Send only the fields to change. A ref can be set once, on a dashboard that has none. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: reorder_visuals

tools.name: publish_dashboard
tools.description: Make the dashboard public for anyone with the link, under the same rules and caps as the app; listing it in the gallery is isShowcase on PATCH. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: unpublish_dashboard

tools.name: revoke_share
tools.description: Revoke one share: the person loses access at once. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: create_visual
tools.description: Create a visual with its document, size and position; with a ref already in this dashboard, return that visual with created false. A ref already used in this dashboard returns that visual, unchanged, with created false. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: batch_update
tools.description: Replace the documents of several visuals at once, keyed by each visual's ref. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: get_visual
tools.description: One visual with its type, title, ref, size, position and document. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: update_visual
tools.description: Change title, document or size; set a ref once on a visual that has none. The type cannot change. Send only the fields to change. The type cannot change; a ref can be set once, on a visual that has none. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: delete_visual
tools.description: Delete the visual, its pointer and its ref, then reflow the rest. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

tools.name: push_visual_data
tools.description: Replace the visual's document; the body is the document itself, valid for the visual's type. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_dashboard · Private data: signup, whoami, create_api_key, get_checkout_link, list_dashboards, create_dashboard, get_dashboard, update_dashboard, reorder_visuals, publish_dashboard, unpublish_dashboard, share_dashboard, list_shares, revoke_share, create_visual, batch_update, get_visual, update_visual, delete_visual, push_visual_data, append_rows, describe_visual_types · Public sink: signup, create_dashboard, update_dashboard, publish_dashboard, share_dashboard, revoke_share, update_visual · Destructive: create_dashboard, delete_visual, append_rows.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_dashboard · Private data: signup, whoami, create_api_key, get_checkout_link, list_dashboards, create_dashboard, get_dashboard, update_dashboard, reorder_visuals, publish_dashboard, unpublish_dashboard, share_dashboard, list_shares, revoke_share, create_visual, batch_update, get_visual, update_visual, delete_visual, push_visual_data, append_rows, describe_visual_types · Public sink: signup, create_dashboard, update_dashboard, publish_dashboard, share_dashboard, revoke_share, update_visual · Destructive: create_dashboard, delete_visual, append_rows

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
